sanskrit: punarhi śrotumicchāmi sārātsārataraṃ paramvadame vastu sadbhāvaṃ prasādaṃ kuru śūla bhṛttadarthaṃ saṃpravakṣyāmi tavasnehānmaheśvariyo sau śānto hyajo devaḥ śaktyādhāro hyavigrahaḥp. 68b) ca caiṣa paramohaṃsaḥ sa vai devaḥ sanātanaḥsadāśivaḥ paraṃdhāma tārakaṃ brahma eva caajñānaṃ caiva tatkṣetraṃ jñānināmavrataḥ sthitamgurvavasthā gamaḥ so hi dṛśyate na tu lakṣyatesa bāhyābhyantarastho hi spandate sarvadehināmavyakto vyaktarūpaśca agrāhyaśca calācalaḥtejorūpī hi bhagavānhṛdvyomnevasthitaḥ paraḥśuddha sphaṭikasaṅkāśaṃ bhinnaṃ vyomni tu vyomavatbhramareṇa pratīkāśaṃ hakāramaśirāhatamsiddhoti nūnaṃ tat tasmiñciva puṣpāṇi paśyatinānākāra vibhāgena dṛśyate parameśvaraḥsadvyomajyotirūposau nadate sa muhurmuhuḥaghaṃśamaya te devi na kvacidyoni sambhavaḥtasya cāpaścimaṃjanma haṃso dṛśyo varānanekṣīyante cāsya karmāṇi tasmin dṛṣṭe parāparepṛthivyāṃ nāsti tad dravyaṃ yad datvā cāriṇī * ? vetkālacihnaparijñānaṃ nādhogatiṣu yogināmtaṃ dṛṣṭvāpi ciraṃ devi punarjanma na vidyaterakto yadā tanurvidyātpīte cārthasya sambhavaḥsubhikṣaṃ ca pracāre ca durbhikṣaṃ cañcu bandhaneañjaliṃ vāripūrṇāyāṃ bhāvayeta vicakṣaṇaḥ

sanskrit: somasūyavibhāgena ahorātraṃ nirīkṣayetpūrve dakṣiṇamāvasyāṃ praviśedravimaṇḍaleekaḥ kālasya paryāyaṃ kathitaṃ tava sundarietaddhi saṃśayaṃ brūhi atrakautūhalaṃ mamayanna kasya cidākhyātaṃ tat te vakṣyāmi suvrateṭha madhyame gatohaṃsaścintanīyaḥ prayatnataḥavyayā sarvagā sūkṣmā parā cāsya parākalākālo na kalayeccātra na jarāvyādhireva caguptosānnidhyamicchanti mātaraḥ sādhakeśvaridātavyaṃ bhakti yuktānāṃ gurubhaktiratātmanāmyo guruḥ sa śivaḥ sākṣāt pūjanīyaḥ prayatnataḥtasya jñānaṃ ca mokṣaṃ ca siddhyate paramārthataḥvalīpalitanirmuktaḥ ṣaṇmāsena bhaviṣyatihaṃsasāraṃ paraṃ brahma paraṃ vyoma paraḥ śivaḥyataste paśavaḥ kīṭā mahāmārgabahiṣkṛtāḥanāśvastā asantuṣṭāḥ paśuśāstreṣu bhāvitāḥoghasarvasvamatulaṃ guruvaktre samāgatamgurubhaktāya śāntāya nityābhyāsaratāya casamayā sevine nityaṃ kulakālodite śiveyataḥ svarasmirūpasthāḥ pīṭhebhyaḥ pīṭhavigrahaḥrakṣantitāḥ kṛpāviṣṭāḥ samayācārapālakāḥvikāsayanti paramaṃ tejo yadvāntasambhṛtampratyakṣarūpo vīrāṇāṃ sa bāhyābhyantaraṃ sthitāḥrahasyaṃ jñeyagamanaṃ bhūmiratramagāhyagākathitaṃ sārasarvasvamumayāsaharaṃ param
